verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents usage-event ingestion APIs and webhooks that could power usage tracking and event-driven alerts (e.g., subscription_cancelled events), giving a technical foundation for usage-based billing, but there is no evidence of a built-in real-time usage dashboard for customers/team or configurable usage thresholds/alerts that warn before an invoice is generated. missing for 10: dedicated real-time usage dashboard for ops/customers, threshold configuration UI, proactive alert/notification system tied to usage overages before invoicing.
